messages:
Sam K: IncidentBot paging — sudden uptick in 429s from eu-west-1 since ~1718601000, console dashboards show queue depth jumping. seeing customer-facing errors. tagging oncall.

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Incident created (INC-20240627-42). Severity: P1. Symptom: 429 surge (write path), 503s intermittent. Auto-escalation to SRE.

Sam K: quick snapshot: dyno-queue 9k -> 45k, 95th latency for text.generate up from 180ms to 950ms, error budget burn starting. rolling window shows correlated retries from 3 tenants.

Ivy L: looking at per-tenant charts — tenant: acme-inc has large fanout, but also saw a burst from internal integration keys. sending link to graph: https://dd.internal/graph/abc123 (posted)

Maria P: I see spikes on ingress proxy for endpoint /v1/generate -> 429 rate-limited by proxy rules? but upstream svc returns 503 occasionally. logs look like upstream queues are full.

Sam K: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply short-lived global QPS dampening on non-critical routes, 2) enable per-tenant emergency cap (500 r/s) for top noisy tenants, 3) disable preview-streaming feature-flag that fans out extra background calls. doing 1 now.

DevOps Bot: deploying config change: traffic-filter/global-backoff -> true (change id cfg-9876). Rolling to proxies in eu-west-1.

Ivy L: running the per-tenant cap script now:
```
# apply emergency cap to tenant list
for t in acme-inc,foo-corp,internal-test; do
  curl -X POST https://api.internal/config/tenant/$t/cap -d '{"rps":500}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN'
done
```

Maria P: disabled preview-streaming via FF toggle (flag: preview_streaming) — went to off for all non-enterprise tiers.

Sam K: telemetry check after changes: queue depth fell from 45k -> 18k in first 60s, 429 rate down 35% so far. still some 503s from model-backend pods (OOM kill on node-12?). putting node-12 into drain.

Ivy L: I see a pod restart loop on model-backend-12, recent logs:
```
OOMKilled at step allocate_kv_cache
stack: ...
mem usage: 63GB / 64GB
```

Maria P: draining node-12 and rescheduling. adding a temporary affinity to prefer nodes with extra GPU memory.

Sam K: adding a short-term routing policy to route lower-priority traffic to lower-cost model variants to reduce memory pressure: route /generate?preview=false -> model-variant v2-small. Pushing policy now.

DevOps Bot: route-policy updated (policy id rp-445).

Ivy L: metrics update: 429s overall down 62% vs peak, 503s down 40%. per-tenant noisy one (acme-inc) still ~30% above baseline but under new cap.

PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Incident reassigned to Ivy L (primary) and Maria P (secondary). Next on-call rotation notified.

Maria P: customer-impact matrix being compiled — acme-inc saw ~12% request failures during window, internal-test had 45% but limited customer exposure. starting a short customer notification draft for impacted customers.

Sam K: long tail items: need to verify whether KV cache allocation can be reduced per-request; will open follow-up ticket to add soft-limits on cache growth. also need post-incident runbook for preview-streaming fanout.

Ivy L: handover plan: I'm staying on this for the next 90 minutes to watch rollback. Maria will follow up with infra for node memory tuning and a permanent model-variant fallback config. Sam will summarize timeline and mitigation actions for postmortem.

Maria P: scheduled a quick dashboard watch: https://dd.internal/dashboards/429503-watch (pinned). also silenced non-critical alerts during mitigation window to cut noise.

Sam K: quick log snippet of an upstream 503:
```
ERROR 503 model-backend: request failed allocate_kv_cache
trace_id=000abc
```

Ivy L: recommendation for next steps (post-stable): 1) enforce tenant-level burst budgets, 2) add automated short-circuit for preview_streaming when queue depth > 10k, 3) capacity planning to avoid single-node memory saturation.

DevOps Bot: telemetry: post-change aggregates show 95th latency down to 220ms, consumer queue latency normalized.

Sam K: closing loop: incident remains active but mitigated. recording this thread into the incident page INC-20240627-42. please add any customer-side notes. handing off to Ivy for monitoring. :white_check_mark:

Ivy L: acknowledged — I'll monitor and escalate if we see a regression. tagging @oncall-next if needed.

Maria P: prepping brief for ops-review and comms. good work team. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Incident INC-20240627-42 update: status=mitigated, next_step=postmortem-scheduled.

Sam K: end of watch — last check shows 429/503 at near baseline. attaching short timeline and commands used to the incident doc.

Ivy L: handing off to Maria for post-incident follow up.

Maria P: will own the RCA and follow-up tasks. thanks everyone.
